items.hyp: Abatujju abaakwatibwa mu kunoonyereza okwaliwo okuttibwa baagamba nti baali baagala okwemmulugunya nti Kayumba yali alina okukwata abantu be.

items.hyp: Abantu bano baasasulira Kayumba okukuba ssente.

items.ref: Wabula, Abanyarwanda bano baagamba nti olw'okuba nti baali basasuddwa nga tebannakola mulimu, baatwala ssente naye tebalina kye baakola.

items.hyp: Abantu abo ku Rwanda abasinga obungi baakozesa obungi.
items.ref: Abanyarwanda babiri abateeberezebwa bamanyiddwa ng'abazzi b'emisango emitonotono.

items.hyp: Gavumenti ya Rwanda yasalawo okukwata ebintu eby'okukwata ku ebyo ebikwata ku kakiiko ka wansi w'akabondo ekiyitibwa ekitongole ky'ensi yonna e Pretoria n'obutale obutali butambulira.

items.hyp: Ab'obuyinza mu South Africa baali baagala okwongera okwongera okwongereza.
items.ref: Aboobuyinza mu South Africa baali babalinnya kagere olw'emisango gyabwe.

items.hyp: Yawangula ne Bill Masetera eyali omu ku ssentebe za South Africa, nga mw'otwalidde ne Patrick Karegyeya era nga mw'otwalidde ne Kayumba.
items.ref: Yeegattibwako eyali akulira bambega e South Africa, Bill Masetera mukwano ennyo gwa Patrick Karegyeya bwe bali ennyo ku mbiranye ne Kayumba.

items.hyp: Masetera yali akulira ekitongole kya NIA ekya South Africa, era Karegyeya yali akulira ekitongole kya Rwanda akakola ku by'okwerinda ekya bantu.
items.ref: Masetera ye yali akulira ekitongole ekikessi mu South Africa Karegyeya gye yali akulira ebyokwerinda wabweru wa South Africa.

items.hyp: Masetera eyalangirira ey'okuwa pulezidenti wa South Africa, Thabo Mbeki, ku kifo ky'okugenda mu kisaawe.
items.ref: Masetera oluvannyuma yafuuka omuwabuzi ku byokwerinda ow'eyaliko pulezidenti wa South Africa, Thabo Mbeki.

items.hyp: Abasajja baali bawulira ku ekyo ekyali kiraga nti Masetera yali akakisa nti yali alina obuwagizi bw'abo abali mu kifo ky'omukulembeze wa Mbeki gwe mu kuvuganya pulezidenti Jacob Zuma.
items.ref: Ababiri baalemagana oluvannyuma lw'ebigambibwa nti Masetera nti yali ayongedde amaanyi mu mulabe wa Mbeki asingayo era Pulezidenti aliko, Jacob Zuma.

items.hyp: Okumala kwe kugamba nti enkungaana ya Masetera n'eya Karegyeya yeeyongera okukola, kyokka kye kiba nti abakuumi ba pulezidenti bakyayongera n'abakuumi ba kintu ky'okukola.
items.ref: Enkolagana ya Masetera ne Karegyeya yeeyongera nga bw'agamba kati, nti bapulezidenti batera okukozesa abakulira obukessi ate bwe bamala ne babasuulawo.

items.ref: Francis Gakwerera agamba nti abeera mu Mozambique gy'abadde addukanyiza bizinensi okuva mu enkumi bbiri mu etaano.

items.hyp: Ekitongole kya fotografi kye kikoleddwa nti kiba kya kufa kubanga kye kyali kikola ku Kodak ne Fuji.

items.hyp: Oluvannyuma lw'okukola emirimu gye kikola mu Mozambique, e Lebanon, Morocco, ne Ethiopia, CinemArena kati mu Uganda.
items.ref: Oluvannyuma lw'okukozesebwa obulungi mu pulojekiti ezaatambula obulungi Mozambique, Lebanon, Morocco ne Ethiopia, ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu kimaze ne kituuka mu Uganda.

items.hyp: Ekitongole kya CinemArena ekiyitibwa Uganda kikola engeri gye kikola mu kusobola okukola eby'obusuubuzi, olw'okuba n'ekitongole ekiyitibwa Italy ne Amakula Film.
items.ref: Ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu mu Uganda kyetooloolera ku kukyusa mbeera z'abantu, okusiima kugende eri Italian cooperation ne Amakula Film.

items.hyp: Abantu abo abasinga obungi mu Gulu, olw'okuba ekimu kyonna kye kikolera, tebajja kuba nnyo okutuuka ku byalo ebitali bimu.

items.hyp: Abantu b'e Gulu bayise okutuuka ku mazima ogw'ekitundu ogw'akakasa.
items.ref: Abantu b'e Gulu bavumu mu obunnyogovu bw'ekiro okutuukira ddala mu matumbi budde.

items.hyp: Ekitongole kya CinemArena kye kyakola okufuna obulungi mu Italy.

items.hyp: Abaawandiika ekitiibwa kya kampuni ekyo bagamba nti ekitongole kya kampuni eyo kya kikwata ku "Yes We Can" eya Barak Obama ey'omu maanyi gamba nti yali akulira okuba mu ofiisi.
items.ref: Abategesi ba pulojekiti bagamba nti omukutu gwabwe ogw'empuliziganya gwekuusa ku ngombo ya Baraka Obama eya "Yes We Can" eyamuyamba okutuuka mu woofiisi.

items.hyp: Marco Ballerini, akulira ekimu yagamba nti okwongera kye kijja kuba kuleetawo abantu okuba n'obuyinza obuli mu by'obulamu okutuukirira eby'okulaba.
items.ref: Marco Ballerini, akulira pulojekiti yagambye nti mu kukola ekyo abantu abalina obukugu bajja kukulemberamu enkulaakulana y'omu maaso.

items.hyp: Ekitundu ekyo ekituuka mu bitundu ebisukka mu 20 e Gulu kyakakasa nga Jjuuni 25 ne Jjulaayi 25.
items.ref: Pulojekiti egenda okukolebwa mu magombolola agasukka amakumi abiri mu disitulikiti y'e Gulu yatandika nga abiri mu ttaano Ogwomukaaga era ya kukomekkerezebwa ng'abiri mu ttaano Ogwomusanvu.

items.hyp: Abantu mu kitundu ekyo e Gulu abali mu kifo ky'okukola emirimu gye kikoleddwa kati bafuuka.

items.hyp: Baagamba nti abamu ku b'omu ku bakiise baayo baasalawo mu UPDF.
items.ref: Baanokolayo nti abamu ku bannaabwe baayingizibwa eggye lya Uganda People's Deforce Force.

items.ref: Obulumbanyi bwa bbomu obwali mu Kampala nga 11 Ogwomusanvu bwava ku nkolagana wakati wa ADF ne bamukwatammundu Abasiraamu aba Al-Shabaab abasangibwa e Somalia.
